acceptanceCriteria: CI responds to merge_group checks_requested and required go-product and doc-gates validate the exact group SHA; unsupported event-specific selection retains full-suite fallback.
Trusted ci-control-plane validates and reports on the exact group SHA without weakening existing CI-change approval policy.
Retain independent review and live evidence for a successful queue merge after explicit owner authorization; failed or stale group handling evidence is split to V1-1319.
Record enablement, queue timeout and concurrency choices, completion only after actual merge, evidence bindings and rollback to previous ruleset.

The queue never narrows (AFP-V0-028, decision 0509): every merge_group run is FULL over the exact group commit, which contains every predecessor in the group, never an individual PR diff or moving main; a rebuild, reorder or missing selection evidence therefore still runs the full suite, and mandatory checks remain required. Forward selection over the combined base_sha..head_sha range is recorded in shadow by V1-0811.
body:
Observed 2026-09-30 via authenticated GitHub API reads of beamfall/corvint main. Public organization repository is eligible; main ruleset 23699808 requires go-product, ci-control-plane, doc-gates and allows merge commits, but has no merge_queue rule. Published ci.yml only triggers pull_request and push(main). Published ci-control-plane.yml accepts only workflow_run.event == pull_request and posts status on PR head SHA. Enabling a merge queue with these definitions would leave required checks missing on its combined SHA. This is a confirmed configuration capability gap; no live queue was enabled or exercised. Reproduction: gh api repos/beamfall/corvint/rules/branches/main and read the two published workflow files. Expected: all required checks validate each queue merge-group SHA while preserving trusted CI-change review. Related V1-0407 covers advisory ordering, not this compatibility prerequisite. Tool versions: gh 2.101.0; Core 1.0.0-rc.1 build 163; Tasks build 202. Official documentation: https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/configuring-branches-and-merges-in-your-repository/configuring-pull-request-merges/managing-a-merge-queue . Owner approval remains required for enablement and live merges. Owner clarified that the requirement is test adequacy over combined queued changes, not just queue admission. Source inspection: corvint affected --base joins the whole base..HEAD diff, but remains advisory with no proof that omitted tests are safe. tools/corvint-pr-tests/main.go:519-528 requires exact two-parent PR merge topology and runPR invokes that profile; no native merge-group qualification was observed. Queue-group support must bind the event base and group head, recompute reachability over the combined tree instead of unioning per-PR selections, and invalidate on queue rebuild. GitHub tests each group/prefix including predecessors, not every later queued PR. Continuation 2026-09-30: independent Gate A found no HIGH in the experimental full-suite group-audit plan. Focused baseline ToolIdentity/affected-package attribution and actionlint passed. Implementation claim twice refused RESOURCE_COLLISION against live attempt 5674ce910f771f06449c084109e406cc; no code changed and no owned attempt exists. Both native queue slots are occupied; admission must be retried after release without overriding other claims. Durable plan and checkpoint: /Users/russelllewis/projects/corvint/.git/worktrees/corvint1/corvint/merge-group-plan.md and merge-group-checkpoint.md. Isolated branch codex/merge-group-tests based on origin/main 5253b7e60d73eb70e7b4cb868bb8ac1c48b625d8 retained, enrolled dogfood key recorded in checkpoint.

Evidence 2026-10-04 (orchestrator session), linked to V1-0752: PR-branch CI does not prove the merged main. origin/main 6bf78ff76889519d43b34cc2a5dfbf42b72e9ba9 (merge of PR 530) failed its own required doc-gates step: `make unbounded-readers-check` reported 56 test units selected on every change against the ceiling 45, exit 1, because eleven unbounded test packages merged to main after PR 530's last CI run (V1-0752 has the reproduction; repaired by PR 544 and V1-0752's PR 550). A merge queue validating the exact merge_group SHA would have refused that merge before main broke. Re-read today via `gh api repos/beamfall/corvint/rules/branches/main`: rule types are only pull_request and required_status_checks (no merge_queue); origin/main cd70ba0a .github/workflows/ci.yml still triggers only on pull_request and push to main, with a concurrency group that cancels in progress (see V1-0728). The capability gap recorded on 2026-09-30 is unchanged; no queue was enabled or exercised.
title: ci: support required checks on GitHub merge group commits
